clare: Quick note  early-access invite for Hosted API Stream Adapter + ToolCall v3. Opt-in period opens tomorrow for 48h. Were asking EA customers to try tool-heavy flows and report any anomalies. :bell:

ben: Nice. Any simple way they can opt in?

clare: Yes, clients set header `X-RW-Tool-Version: 3` on requests. Omitting header leaves current behavior unchanged.

ops-bot: Canary snapshot: 12h across two regions, no regression signals. p95 improved ~6% on short responses.

docs: Ill publish a 1-page EA guide and a curl example in #docs in ~30m.

cs: Preparing an EA customer note: emphasize no billing changes and recommend running in staging first. Will include contact path for quick rollback.

release-coordinator: Release tag stream-adapter@1.2 promoted to canary sets. If any region error delta >0.5% we auto-toggle adapter off in that region.

ben: Deprecation timeline for old toolcall versions?

clare: Well keep v1/v2 for 9 months. At month 6 we start in-app nudges and SDK warnings; formal deprecation notice at month 8.

ops-bot: Action items created: docs publish, EA email, SDK patches (node/python today), extend canary if needed.

clare: Thanks all. EA customers: please paste request ids here if you see anything odd. Well flip default after opt-in if telemetry is green. :rocket:
